title: Mehtab Singh Beheads Massa Ranghar at Amritsar

blocks.text: Mehtab Singh and Sukha Singh reach Amritsar at a carefully chosen moment. At the height of noon, when heat, rain, and routine have dulled the vigilance of the guards, they enter disguised as revenue officials carrying business for the local authorities.

Inside the desecrated complex they find Massa Ranghar absorbed in entertainment and unprepared for danger. Mehtab Singh strikes decisively and chops off his head before the garrison can understand what has happened.
The deed is both revenge and restoration. By escaping immediately after the blow, the two Sikhs turn a sacrilegious scene into one of remembered Khalsa courage and righteous retaliation.
